Purpose and exclusions

A placed gate validates a catalog destination and delegates individual cross-zone handoff.

Never bypass the declared rule owner, mutate an authored definition at runtime, trust a client completion claim, or infer a compiled implementation from this page.

Creation and configuration

  1. Build native AActor-derived gate and BP_ZoneGate; implement the registered interaction interface through the native dispatcher.
  2. Assign reciprocal Rillmere/Thornweald catalog gate IDs in placed instances, not raw server addresses in Blueprint. Runtime allocation resolves the endpoint through the trusted service.
  3. Use a visible road/gate marker and a clear standing area. Reopen the loading UI/transfer adapter and bind Pending/Rejected/Arrived results to this selected player only.

Required sequence: create native prerequisites -> actual build -> child/data creation -> configure -> assign to listed consumer -> save -> run named fixture. A compiled shell without its consumer assignment is not feature completion.

Lifecycle and cleanup

  1. Construct with only safe defaults; no service calls or world scans from construction scripts.
  2. Inject current owner/definition/session and subscribe once after readiness. Possession and replicated state may arrive in either order; guard initialization.
  3. Accept only permitted commands under current identity/epoch; keep local UI/cosmetic prediction separate from committed state.
  4. After server/backend result apply only matching request generation and nonstale revision; late reply to old body does not mutate new body.
  5. On death, transfer, disconnect, restart or teardown cancel transient work, clear input/timers, unbind delegates and release weak observers. Durable receipts remain authoritative.
  6. On reconnect create fresh runtime objects from current committed snapshot; never deserialize old Actor/widget pointers or rerun initial grants.

Concrete player-to-authority flow

Participation in Biome servers, loading screens and fenced handoff. Rule owner: URPGZoneTransferComponent. This asset’s role is A placed gate validates a catalog destination and delegates individual cross-zone handoff.

  1. Player interaction reaches source server; verify gate actor, range/LOS, destination/return entrance, character eligibility and no disallowed combat/death state.
  2. Freeze new economic starts and drain/reconcile accepted commands. Persist current accepted snapshot with expected revision; never serialize a client UI inventory.
  3. Backend reserves a destination instance with free capacity and records Preparing transfer state under the current fenced character lease. On failure unfreeze source safely.
  4. Create a short-lived signed ticket bound to account, character, destination and revision. Deliver it through the authenticated session channel; avoid placing bearer credentials in logs or long-lived URLs.
  5. Source instructs only the owning controller to ClientTravel to the allocated server endpoint using absolute travel. A loading screen spans disconnect/connect; other controllers do not travel.
  6. Destination validates identity/ticket/reservation, then atomically consumes the ticket and changes session ownership/epoch in the backend. Old source writes immediately become fenced, even before visual acknowledgement.
  7. Destination loads the agreed snapshot, spawns one body guarded by CharacterId+epoch, restores persistent facts without replaying grants, and enables input only after hydration/possession readiness.
  8. Arrival acknowledgement retires the frozen source body and reservation. If destination crashes after redemption, recovery obtains a later epoch; it never reuses a consumed token or reactivates old authority.

Named fixture and acceptance

Fixture: L_Rillmere / Gate_East / L_Thornweald / Gate_West / Server_A / Server_B. Configure this asset at its first phase and run the linked phase recipe. Actual result: not run in Unreal/backend during documentation generation.

Stimulus / expected result
Client_A travels while Client_B remains -> A arrives at Gate_West, B stays in Rillmere and Server_A remains alive.
Source crash before redeem -> backend resolves Preparing state and reconnects with one valid lease, no lost committed craft.
Duplicate ticket -> AlreadyUsed; no second pawn or reward replay.
Destination full -> ZoneFull before departure when possible; source unfreezes or recovery sends to safe hub with a new valid reservation.

Record expected/observed separately. Reopen the concrete map consumer; inspect authoritative state, stable IDs/revisions and UI. Static link checks cannot satisfy this gameplay test.

Common mistakes and staged limits

Do not duplicate a native rule in Blueprint, assume a planned type is compiled, or keep callbacks/owners valid after world or session replacement.

Do not build later references as empty shells in an earlier phase. Source-derived art rows remain blocked by the missing ZIP; plugin API bindings remain blocked by installed-source verification. Placeholder visuals and proposed tuning are explicitly not production proof.
